text: Tameeni, the online insurance platform, is one of Rasan Information Technology Company's flagship subsidiaries and the business that began Rasan's insurtech operations in 2017.
short: Tameeni is a flagship platform of Rasan Information Technology Company.

source.name: Rasan Information Technology Company - Our Businesses (Tameeni)
source.quote: Tameeni marked the beginning of Rasan's disruption of Saudi Arabia's insurance market in 2017
source.note: Rasan's own business page; the same page describes the insurtech verticals (Motor, Health, Life, General) sold through Tameeni. Page copyright 2025.

additionalSources.name: MENAbytes: Saudi fintech Rasan goes public on Tadawul
additionalSources.quote: Founded in 2016, Rasan operates Tameeni, Saudi Arabia’s largest online insurance aggregator
